headline: US Short-Term Treasury Yields Gain Ahead of $114 Billion Bond Auctions
summary: US Treasury yields rose at the short end of the curve as markets prepared for upcoming Treasury Department sales of $70 billion in 5-year notes and $44 billion in 7-year notes.
why: US Treasury yields serve as foundational global interest rate benchmarks, influencing mortgages, corporate debt issuance, and foreign exchange values.

impacts.name: US 10-year Treasury yield
impacts.why: Increased Treasury debt supply pushed yields higher across short and medium-term maturity notes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Traders repriced US government bonds higher in yield to absorb $114 billion in new government debt issuance.
